description: Single-page marketing/product site — the default for most vague 'make me a website for X' requests when X is a product, app, or service.

default_sections.purpose: Headline + short subheadline + primary CTA button
default_sections.fill_guidance: Headline should state what the thing is or does in plain language, using the subject the user mentioned (e.g. 'bakery' → bread/pastry-oriented headline).
3-4 short items describing what's offered. Infer plausible generic items for the stated subject if user gave none.
Include only if the subject implies paid offerings (SaaS, product, service). Omit for things like a personal portfolio or a purely informational bakery site with no online ordering mentioned.
Include for anything with a credibility/trust angle (service businesses, SaaS). Use placeholder-style generic quotes, never invent named real people.
Restate the primary action from the hero (sign up, order now, contact us) in a simpler closing form.
Links matching whichever sections are actually present in this instance.

notes: This is a structure pattern, not a template pointer — template selection happens as a separate step against whatever's in the live registry at request time.
'required: false' sections should only be added when the user's subject plausibly calls for them — don't pad every site with every optional section by default.
